title.narrative: Building Resilience for climate change adaptation and combating hunger in south eastern Madagascar

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is the strengthened resilience to climate shocks of vulnerable individuals, households, communities, and systems in targeted communities. The project will strengthen food and nutrition security and provide communities, including schoolchildren, with safe, diverse, and nutritious food produced locally from smallholder' farmers.
Main activities: - Productivity support for smallholder farmers - Financial inclusion package impl. with savings and crop index insurance system for smallholder farmers - Support and train vulnerable hh to diversify livelihoods with non-farm activities - Set up food processing units to increase availability of nutrient-rich and safe foods and impl. a social marketing plan - Impl. a large-scale social marketing strategy to support demand of high nutrition dense food - Support existing safety nets programmes using cash-based modality with smallholder farmers and processing units’ food production - Impl. a large-scale social behaviour change strategy to support adherence to nutrition, WASH best practices and climate-adapted practices
Intended outcomes: 1: Targ. smallholder farmers and vulnerable hh have improved and diversified livelihoods 2: Targ. communities and schoolchildren have an improved and adequate nutritious food intake/practices 3: Targ. communities have effective and long-lasting utilization of quality basic social services and diversified, nutritious diets
Intended outputs: 1.1: Smallholder farmers have improved and stabilized production capacities 1.2: Vulnerable hh have diversified livelihoods 2.1: Targeted communities and children have access and use of nutritious foods/ practices 3.1: Communities and vulnerable hh have an improved access and use of inclusive, quality, gender-sensitive basic social services
WFP, in collaboration with UNICEF as main delivery partner, will provide support in the South-East part of Madagascar (districs Mananjary and Manakara).
